digest.component_or_area: remediation epic: CI reliability, documentation, code quality
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker crashes during test_opcert_service_app teardown due to load-dependent pytest-xdist race condition (OSError on already-closed connection)
User-facing documentation example teaches an assignee/Jira identity that is inconsistent with docs/config.md

Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py mix responsibilities across layers causing high complexity; must be decomposed by responsibility with one-way dependency direction while preserving public import paths

Graph loader and traversal logic is duplicated across four functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) causing high cyclomatic complexity; must centralize shared infrastructure without changing node-set semantics
attest package fails strict mypy type-checking with --disallow-untyped-defs due to unannotated definitions
